scoring_justification: The paper's main claim is a set of directional changes (occupancy mean shift, transport metric trends) that can be verified structurally; absolute recompute from raw trajectories is not feasible because the verifier cannot run the full MD simulation.

outputs.description: Normalized probability density of the continuous occupancy N_c for flexibility parameter φ=0.
Normalized probability density of the continuous occupancy N_c for flexibility parameter φ=1.3.
Summary table of water transport metrics for φ=0 and φ=1.3.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compute the mean N_c from each occupancy histogram and verify that mean(φ=1.3) < mean(φ=0), and from the transport summary verify that avg_N_w(1.3) < avg_N_w(0), N_exit(1.3) < N_exit(0), and t_tr(1.3) > t_tr(0). Absolute numerical agreement is not required.

steps.description: Verify occupancy_phi_0.csv exists, has required columns, bin range 0-8, and is a valid normalized probability density.
Verify transport_summary.csv exists, has required columns, and contains rows for phi=0 and phi=1.3.
Compute weighted mean N_c from both occupancy histograms and verify that mean(phi=1.3) < mean(phi=0).
Verify all three transport trends: avg_N_w(1.3) < avg_N_w(0), N_exit(1.3) < N_exit(0), t_tr(1.3) > t_tr(0).
